title: The Ring (2002 film) — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Modern psychology keeps rediscovering what the pessimists said first about The Ring (2002 film). The Ring is a 2002 American supernatural horror film directed by Gore Verbinski and written by Ehren Kruger. The film follows Rachel Keller (Watts), a journalist who discovers a cursed VHS tape that causes its viewers to die seven days later.

Once you see The Ring (2002 film) as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. A third installment, also titled Rings, was released on February 3, 2017. This film served as a direct sequel to the 2002 film, which ignores the events of both the short film and The Ring Two.
